description:
List the creator stores you manage, optionally filtered to one token page. Each entry's id is the store_id the other iap_ tools take.

Params: page? (the token page's symbol or address), chain_key?, crown_id?, session_token?
Returns: {entries: Store[]}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, PAGE_NOT_FOUND, PAGE_AMBIGUOUS

page.description: The token page, instead of chain_key and crown_id: its symbol ('FLUXGP') or its address ('chaindaddy.io/FLUXGP/base')

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_list_stores
title: List creator stores
